items.source_name: Texas Politics Project (UT Austin) via Political Wire
items.summary: UT/Texas Politics Project October poll (Sept 25-Oct 5, 861 LV, MoE +/-3.34): Talarico 50-47 over Paxton (Libertarian Ted Brown 1%); Hinojosa 49-48 over Abbott. Dems also lead down-ballot: Lt. Gov Goodwin 49-46 Patrick, AG Johnson 48-47 Middleton, Railroad Comm. Rosenthal 47-46 French; GOP leads Comptroller (Huffines 47-46 Eckhardt). Key driver: 72% of Dems 'extremely/very' enthusiastic vs 62% of GOP; independents break Talarico 69-11. Talarico trusted more on cost of living, healthcare, corruption, voting/elections, moral values.
items.title: UT/Texas Politics Project poll: Talarico 50-47, Hinojosa 49-48; Dems lead down-ballot too

items.summary: Marist October Texas poll (Oct 8-11, LV, MoE +/-4.9): Talarico 47-45 over Paxton among likely voters (+4 among RV, down from +6 in September); 52% of LV independents back Talarico. Split picture otherwise: generic congressional ballot favors GOP 51-46 among LV (Democrats had +3 among RV last month); Abbott leads Hinojosa 49-45 among LV (Hinojosa +1 among RV, down from +3 last month). 53% of LV still think Paxton will win; 68% of RV think Abbott is re-elected. Note: some crypto-news sites recycling the poll cited the OLD September Marist read (50-44, RV) - not the new numbers.
items.title: Marist October TX poll: Talarico 47-45; Abbott 49-45; generic ballot GOP +5 among LV
